Description: Household number
One administrative level about census tract in each country - for example, county in Kenya and state in Nigeria
Enumeration area for the survey - census tract in some countries, neighborhood or village in others.
Country name
Date on which interview took place in year-month-day format
The number of people currently living in the household at the time of interview
The number of household members not living in the household at the time of the interview
For household migrants only: current location is national or international
Whether migrant is from household or not; NAs are houses with no migrants and no remittances
For household migrants only: how long the migrant has lived in the current location, in months
The loading of the household on the first principal component from a principal component analysis of items that are local indicators of wealth; for further details, see Rutstein (2015)
Whether the household received any remittances from any migrants in the last 12 months
Whether money or food were received from the migrant in  the last 12 months
Latitute of census tract, to the nearest landmark; located with Google Maps, Map Carta, ChatGPT, or a combination
Longitude of census tract, to the nearest landmark; located with Google Maps, Map Carta, ChatGPT, or a combination
Latitude of the SPEI grid point nearest the census tract
Longitude of the SPEI grid point nearest the census tract
Latitude of the nearest population center (derived from nighttime lights data; Hall et al 2019)
Longitude of the nearest population center (derived from nighttime lights data; Hall et al 2019)
The annual frequency of drought onsets, averaged across the 2005-2009 period for the participant's census tract
First, calculate the cumulative deviation from the 10th percentile during a single drought for a given census tract; then take the mean of those cumulative deviations over 2005-2009
Variance in drought frequency divided by mean drought frequency for the participant's census tract across the 2005-2009 period
The average spatial extent of droughts for the participant's census tract across the 2005-2009 period, in meters
The average of the monhtly Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) for the participant's census tract across the five-year period
The severity (see above for how calculated) applied to the Standardized Vegetation Index (compares current vegetation to climatological mean)
The distance as the crow flies from the lat/long of the censust tract to the lat/long of the nearest population center
